title: The Khalsa Breaks the Pathan Line

blocks.text: Battle erupts with unmistakable visual force. The Khalsa emblems did the Singhs unfurl, war cries rise, muskets fire, and then the Khalsa force drew their swords for the close charge that shatters the enemy's nerve.

The rout becomes one-sided very quickly. Those who resist are cut down, Khalsa Panth, being merciful, spared his life where surrender is real, and Ala Singh strikes from the other side as captured artillery and weapons prove how thoroughly the Pathan position has collapsed.
This page is the campaign's martial center. It combines religious symbolism, tactical speed, and controlled ferocity in a decisive Khalsa victory.
